name: D-ID
shortDescription: Talking-head video from a photo and a script. A 14-day trial is listed.
longDescription: D-ID's docs say a photo and a script become a talking-head video, and the studio page says text, audio, or a still image can become an avatar video without a camera crew. The help center lists a 14-day free trial and paid Studio plans. The pricing page does not show one monthly dollar amount.
pricingNotes: The help center lists a 14-day trial and paid Studio plans. No single monthly price was readable on the page we fetched.
bestFor: A talking-head video from a photo and a script
strength: The official talking-head docs say a photo and a script become a video, and the help center lists a 14-day trial.
weakness: The studio pricing page names paid plans but does not show one monthly dollar amount.
smokeTestNotes: Studio, API, and help-center pages reviewed on 2026-10-19.

useCaseFit.avatar-video: Turns a photo and a script into a talking-head video.
